grammar_focus: 过去完成时(主考:had+过去分词 · after/before/as soon as/when/until 引导 · 两个过去动作里更早的用过去完成 · 否定 had not · 一般过去 vs 过去完成辨析)+ had planned/hoped 未实现的计划(辅考讲深)+ It was the…time that…had done(辅考讲深)+ 反身代词(辅考:形式/作宾语/强调,同步L14章+课文 himself)
scene: 去年在法国旅行搭载招手青年 · 全程用法语没说话 · 快到镇上时青年突然慢慢问"你会讲英语吗"——原来他也是英国人

grammar_card.title: 说"在另一件过去的事之前已经做了"(过去完成时)
grammar_card.intro: 本课讲怎么说"过去的两件事里,哪一件先发生"——先发生的那件用过去完成时。全用本课句子举例。

rows: 过去完成时 = had + 过去分词(表示'过去的过去')
After I had left the village, I drove on.(先离开,后开车)
两个过去动作里,先发生的用过去完成,后发生的用一般过去
As soon as he had gotten in, I said good morning.(先上车,后问好)
常配 after / before / as soon as / when 连词
When he had finished lunch, he asked for water.
否定:had not + 过去分词;常和 until 连用
I had not understood the problem until he explained it.

specialRules.rule: 相继发生、按顺序讲的动作,用一般过去时(and/but 连接);过去完成时是'回头看'更早发生的那件事
specialRules.mark: 过去 vs 过去完成

specialRules.rule: had planned/hoped/intended to + 原形,表示'本打算…(但没实现)'

prelisten.q: Listen and answer — Did the young man speak English?
options: No, he was silent the whole time

passage: I had an amusing experience last summer while I was on vacation in France. After I had left a small village in the south of France, I drove on toward the next town. On the way, a young man waved at me and asked me for a lift. As soon as he had gotten into the car, I said good morning to him in French. He replied in the same language, so I figured he was a local Frenchman. Apart from a few words, I did not know any French at all. Neither of us spoke during the whole journey. I had nearly reached the town when the young man suddenly turned to me. Very slowly, he asked, "Do you speak English?" I was surprised, because before he spoke, I had thought he was French. As I soon learned, the young man was English himself!

过去完成时——用法:两个过去动作里更早的用过去完成

一般过去 vs 过去完成 辨析

stage5.stem: 过去完成时由什么构成?
"After I ___ the village, I drove on."(leave,先离开，过去完成)
stage5.stem_cn: 我离开村庄后,继续往前开。

stage5.stem: "When he ___ lunch, he asked for water."(finish,先吃完，过去完成)
stage5.stem_cn: 他吃完午饭后,要了些水。

stage5.stem: 过去完成时用来表示什么?
options: 过去两个动作里,先发生的那个

stage5.stem: "As soon as he had gotten into the car, I said hi." 哪件事先发生?
"The children ran away ___ they had broken the window."(在…之后)
stage5.stem_cn: 孩子们打碎窗户之后就跑掉了。

stage5.stem: "___ the sun had set, we returned to the hotel."(太阳一下山就…)
stage5.stem_cn: 太阳一下山,我们就回了旅馆。

stage5.stem: "She went to the post office ___ she had written the letter."(先写完信)
"I ___ the problem until he explained it."(否定 + until,过去完成)
stage5.stem_cn: 直到他解释,我才弄懂这个问题。

stage5.stem: 关于一般过去时和过去完成时,正确的是:
options: 相继发生按顺序讲用一般过去;回头看更早的用过去完成
一般过去时表此刻正在

stage5.stem: "He arrived and (then) sat down." 两件相继发生、按顺序讲,用:
options: 过去完成(had arrived, had sat)

stage5.stem: "When I got to the station, the train ___ already ___."(我到之前车已开走，过去完成)
stage5.stem_cn: 我到车站时,火车已经开走了。

stage5.stem: "I ___ to go shopping, but my mom came."(本打算…但没成)
stage5.stem_cn: 我本打算去购物,但我妈妈来了。

stage5.stem: "She ___ that he would come, but he didn't."(原本希望…但落空)
stage5.stem_cn: 她原本希望他会来,但他没来。

stage5.stem: "It was the third time that I ___ him."(正式/书面:此句式规范用过去完成)
过去完成时的否定是:
"___ you ever seen him before that day?"(过去完成疑问)
"By six o'clock, they ___ dinner."(到六点之前已吃完，过去完成)
stage5.stem_cn: 到六点时,他们已经吃完晚饭了。

stage5.stem: "他自己"的反身代词是:
"God helps those who help ___."(动作回到自己身上,用反身代词)
stage5.stem_cn: 天助自助者(上天帮助自己帮自己的人)。

stage5.stem: "The young man was English ___."(强调"他本人就是",课文原句)
stage5.stem_cn: 那青年本人就是英国人。
